title: SCMowns john mod
description: This project is a complete remake of SCMowns's john mod from scratch. adds johns and a few features.
body:
This mod 100% remakes the john mod revival by SCMowns in 2012. it adds all the johns and most of the abilities and features. SPOILERS ALERT!


Features: 
-john has a 33% chance of dropping 1 immortaility gem. however, 2 gems will drop with a 12% chance.
-john can climb walls.
-john has 40 health and does 3 damage and has 3 resistance.
-slighty rarer
-all are immune to fire and fall damage.
-baby john spawns in groups of 5 to 6
-more common
-baby john has 15 health and does 4 damage and has 1 resistance.
-baby john drops XP bottles.
-mega john is very rare
-mega john has 600 health and does 30 damage and has 10 resistance.
-mega john knockbacks the player
-mega john drops 2 diamonds and has a 5% chance of dropping the blade itself.
-the immortailty gem is used to craft the immortailty sword in a sword pattern.
-the immortailty sword does 6 damage, 1561 durability, lights enemies on fire, does more damage to john.



credits: SCMowns, kurtss.
